data.body:
2026-09-07 follow-up to the ticketing phase. The operator asked for the baseline-maintenance decision in plain language and for the ticket-history reason that value-preserving baseline key re-spells are prohibited; dependencies were confirmed as intended.

Findings from the history (dystopian-bardlike-basil d319-a094-4ee7-4549, celadon-computable-smelts a1f1-a30d-2d50-4f5a, satin-fullgrown-shibainu affd-913c-3fb0-40fb, task 47e9, commit 81da792): the complexity baseline is locked by a CI step (`check_complexity_baseline.py --lock`) that diffs the change against main's merge base and rejects any added key, with administrator force-submit as the designed override, so a path re-spell is rejected regardless of value; the mechanism baseline has no CI lock but the operator's 2026-09-06 ruling on a1f1 forbids making it contributor-editable because agents abuse exception paths; the sanctioned contributor path is "land it, change nothing" for reductions and the `mechanism-ok` marker for additions. New defect found: `_run_update_stale` (`scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py:177-195`) refuses on `compare()`'s marker-blind `has_regression`, so any marker-admitted mechanism outside the baseline blocks every drain, and a change that removes one mechanism and adds a marked one cannot pass `test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree`.

Operator decisions (approved 2026-09-07): (1) the drain in the same change stays the rule for removals; AGENTS.md and docs/architecture.md are reworded and `--update-stale` is made marker-aware; filed as bug amoeboid-amateur-guillemot (1768-5b6f-958a-43e9, priority 1, discovered_from a1f1; the config epic unhygienic-houndlike-arrowworm now depends on it because its test-hook story citified-earth-cottontail is blocked by the defect). (2) The reconciler package-move story gunshy-symmetric-barnacle keeps its six-key complexity-baseline re-spell and the operator force-submits that one change once the lock step is its only red CI item; the implementing agent hands off, never overrides. (3) The 29-key mechanism-baseline re-spell in emblematic-apostolic-mouse is a sanctioned one-time maintenance edit, named in the commit message, with a reviewer check (strip the moved prefix, sort name and value, diff main against the change) posted on the story. All three decisions are recorded as comments on the affected tickets.
